major-orders.title: Major Orders
major-orders.description: Major Orders are community-wide, large-scale objectives that direct the course and narrative of the Second Galactic War. They can require Helldivers to liberate or hold planets, defend worlds, exterminate enemy forces, gather resources, or complete operations before a deadline. Success can award Medals, Requisition, equipment, Stratagems, or other campaign rewards.

meridian-black-hole.title: Meridian Black Hole
meridian-black-hole.description: The Meridian Black Hole formed when Helldivers injected Dark Fluid into the Terminid Supercolony on Meridia, causing the planet to collapse in June 2184. Although initially treated as a black hole, later events revealed the anomaly to function as a wormhole tied to Illuminate activity. It became one of the most strategically important anomalies of the Second Galactic War and a major focus of later Illuminate operations.

the-gloom.title: The Gloom
the-gloom.description: The Gloom is an interstellar Terminid spore cloud that emerged from deep Terminid territory in 2184. It obscures galactic intelligence, disrupts communications, and is associated with extreme evolutionary pressure that has produced dangerous new Terminid strains. The Gloom later revealed heavily transformed Hive Worlds and has receded from some previously engulfed planets while still covering others.

the-void.title: The Void
the-void.description: The Void was an unnatural Illuminate interstellar anomaly formed as the final stage of an Exostorm. It engulfed multiple star systems, blocked conventional observation and signals, and severely disrupted navigation and intelligence gathering. Super Earth penetrated the anomaly during Operation Void Piercer, and the Void was ultimately dissolved after Seasse was secured on August 23, 2186.

void-gateway.title: Void Gateway
void-gateway.description: The Void Gateway was a Super Earth-controlled connection point between normal space and the Void on Rirga Bay. Engineers used modified Alcubierre Drive warp bubbles to penetrate the Void's outer radiation shell, and a massive Warp Relay Station was constructed to generate a protective bubble large enough to transport multiple Super Destroyers and even the Democracy Space Station into the anomaly.

void-sector.title: Void Sector
void-sector.description: The Void Sector was a temporary Galactic Map region containing planets engulfed by the Void. Conventional galactic intelligence was heavily obstructed within the anomaly. The region became accessible during Operation Void Piercer and ceased to exist after the Void was dispelled, with its affected planets returning to their pre-Void forms.

tcs-plus-breaches.title: TCS+ Breaches
tcs-plus-breaches.description: The TCS+ Breaches are a series of Terminid outbreaks and attacks affecting planets protected by the Terminid Control System+ network. Despite the system being presented as a permanent containment line, multiple TCS+ worlds suffered renewed Terminid activity, with Super Earth attributing several incidents to dissident sabotage. Notable late-August 2186 breaches included Brilliance and an assault on Achernar Secundus by the Predator Strain.

counterdissident-hammer.title: Counterdissident Hammer
counterdissident-hammer.description: Counterdissident Hammer is a Super Earth campaign launched on August 25, 2186 after renewed Terminid outbreaks within the completed TCS+ containment line. Super Earth blamed extremist dissident sabotage for the breaches and initiated a galaxy-wide counter-dissidence operation while Helldivers responded to Terminid incursions. The campaign opened with the Dissident Manhunt phase.
